notes: Plain-text 10-K of a commodity pool. Item 9A has two headings: 'Item 9A. CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES' (line 1224) with the full disclosure, then 'Item 9A(T). CONTROLS AND PROCEDURES' (line 1284) with only 'Not applicable.'. There is no id for 9A(T), so Item 9A is labeled at the first heading and the 9A(T) heading stays inside it. Item 8 incorporates the financial statements from Exhibit 13.01 but prints the quarterly supplementary data, and Item 13 cites the annual report but also states the brokerage fees, so neither is marked incorporated. Items 3, 4, 9 and 9B say 'None.', which is an answer, so they are not marked incorporated. The line 'Items 6 and 8.' inside Item 1 is a wrapped cross-reference, not a heading. The filing ends at SIGNATURES; the exhibit index and the attached Charter Series annual report to limited partners (Exhibit 13.01) follow it.
